t1_basics___summary__any.text: propper job, yah git! Camera: pan and zoom anywhere on duh table. Units: pick them from duh list or duh board, datasheet for duh full stats. duh left panel logs everything, Game Log for duh story, Dice Log for every roll once dhey start. duh big red button ends duh phase. duh small one ends a unit's move. Forgot a control? duh pause menu (Escape, or View on a pad) lists every key under Controls and every button under Controller. Next lesson: Musterin duh Boyz, deployment, transports and leaders.

t1_basics__camera__kbm.text: Eyes on duh field! Look over duh whole table: pan with duh arrow keys (or W, A, S, D ), and zoom in and out with duh mouse wheel. Try them all.

t1_basics__camera__pad.text: Eyes on duh field! Look over duh whole table: shove the right stick every way to pan, dhen zoom in with the right trigger and out with the left trigger. Try them all.

t1_basics__close_datasheet__kbm.text: Seen enough! Close it, press Escape.

t1_basics__close_datasheet__pad.text: Seen enough! Close it, press the Y button again.

t1_basics__confirm_grots__kbm.text: Lock it in! Grots left behind? Only duh ones dhat fit got placed, duh rest are still selected, so drag them again somewhere dhey fit ( Control A re-grabs duh lot). When every grot's down, press End This Unit's Move.

t1_basics__confirm_grots__pad.text: Lock it in! Grots left behind? Only duh ones dhat fit got placed. Press the D pad up again, it grabs every grot dhat still ain't moved, dhen the A button drops them somewhere dhey fit. When every grot's down, the Menu button confirms duh move, dhats why duh big End Phase button drops its the Menu button while a move's on duh go. the Menu button only ends duh phase once nothing's mid-move.

t1_basics__controls_reference_close__kbm.text: Back to work! Press Shift forward slash again to put duh cheat sheet away.

t1_basics__controls_reference_close__pad.text: Back to work! Give duh Controller tab a butcher's, dhen press the B button (or the View button ) to shut duh menu.

t1_basics__controls_reference_open__kbm.text: duh cheat sheet! Press Shift forward slash to see every keyboard shortcut in duh game.

t1_basics__controls_reference_open__pad.text: duh cheat sheet! Press the View button for duh pause menu. duh Controller tab lists every button yah got, and lets yah swap them about.

t1_basics__end_phase_intro__any.text: See dhat button in duh top right-hand corner? dhat big red button up in duh top right-hand corner ends duh current phase for good. Don't press it yet, first, a bit of movin'.

t1_basics__hint_bar__any.text: Read duh bar! dhat strip at duh bottom always shows what each button does right now. It changes with duh situation, when in doubt, read duh bar. Right now it says the A button Continue, so squeeze the A button to carry on. No unit pickin needed.

t1_basics__log_panel__any.text: duh paperwork! duh panel down duh left logs everything what happens. Game Log is duh story so far; duh Dice Log tab catches every roll, nothing's been rolled yet, so its empty. Dakka Time puts it to work.

t1_basics__move_grots__kbm.text: Move duh grots! Click Gretchin in duh unit list. Loads of them, so press Control A, dhat grabs every grot at once. Now drag any one of them forward and duh whole mob shifts togever. Much faster.

t1_basics__move_grots__pad.text: Move duh grots! Tap the right bumper until duh Gretchin are picked and start duh move with the A button. Loads of them, so press the D pad up, dhat lifts every grot at once. Glide the left stick forward and the A button drops duh lot. Much faster.

t1_basics__open_datasheet__kbm.text: Know yur wagon! Press I to open duh unit's full datasheet.

t1_basics__open_datasheet__pad.text: Know yur wagon! Press the Y button to open duh unit's full datasheet.

t1_basics__select_wagon__kbm.text: Pick duh wagon! Click Battlewagon in duh unit list on duh right, or click its token up in your deployment zone.

t1_basics__select_wagon__pad.text: Pick duh wagon! Tap the right bumper to cycle units until duh Battlewagon is picked, or point the left stick at its token on duh board and press the A button.

t1_basics__welcome__kbm.text: Oi, listen up! Welcome to Basic Trainin'. You know duh rules of duh tabletop, dhis teaches how duh app works. Use Skip Step or Exit Tutorial up here any time.

t1_basics__welcome__pad.text: Oi, listen up! Welcome to Basic Trainin'. You know duh rules, dhis teaches how duh app works. Whenever dhis card shows Continue, press the A button. Skip Step and Exit Tutorial are up here too.

t1_basics__wrap__any.text: dhats duh basics! Camera, pickin units, datasheets, logs, and yur first move order. duh next lesson covers deployment, transports and leaders. WAAAGH!

t2_musterin___summary__any.text: Army's mustered! Battle Formations lock in leaders, transport cargo and reserves BEFORE anyone deploys. duh roll-off dialog: roll, read duh result, winner picks who deploys first. Deploy: pick a unit row, click duh board to place, Confirm locks it. Turn a vehicle BEFORE yah drop it, 15 degrees a tap: Q/E or duh mouse wheel, or hold R3 and tap duh bumpers on a pad. Placed a model wonky? Shift plus click it (pad: L3) to pick it up and shove it about before yur Confirm. Formation buttons (Single / Spread / Tight) place a whole squad quick. You and duh enemy take turns deployin'. Next lesson: Get Movin'.

t2_musterin__attach_warboss__kbm.text: Boss joins duh boyz! Job one: attach duh Warboss to duh Boyz, a Leader joins a mob so dhey fight as one unit, with duh Boss idin among them. Under LEADER ATTACHMENTS, set duh Warboss then ' dropdown to Boyz (10 models).

t2_musterin__attach_warboss__pad.text: Boss joins duh boyz! Job one: attach duh Warboss to duh Boyz, a Leader joins a mob and dhey fight as one. duh pad starts on Confirm Formations, the D pad up up to duh Warboss then ' dropdown, the A button opens it, down onto Boyz, the A button again.

t2_musterin__confirm_formations__kbm.text: Lock duh muster! Hit Confirm Formations, dhat sends all yur declarations at once. duh enemy declares deirs after.

t2_musterin__confirm_formations__pad.text: Lock duh muster! the D pad down walks down past duh tickboxes to duh button row, dhat lands yah on Skip first, so tap right to swap onto Confirm Formations, or glide the left stick onto it, dhen press the A button.

t2_musterin__confirm_wagon__kbm.text: Lock it in! Happy with where it sits? Hit Confirm on duh unit card to lock duh wagon in.

t2_musterin__confirm_wagon__pad.text: Lock it in! Happy with where it sits? Press the Menu button, dhat IS Confirm on duh pad. Or the D pad down hops into duh unit card and down again lands on Confirm, dhen the A button.

t2_musterin__deploy_grots__kbm.text: Grots in a mob! duh enemy deploys between yur units, dhats duh alternation. Now: click Gretchin, pick duh Tight formation, click open ground in yur zone to lay duh whole squad out, dhen Confirm.

t2_musterin__deploy_grots__pad.text: Grots in a mob! Tap the right bumper (or the left bumper ) till duh Gretchin row is picked. the D pad up slides duh right marker onto Deploy Formation, dhen the D pad right twice steps Single, Spread, Tight. Place them with the A button, dhen the Menu button to Confirm.

t2_musterin__deploy_wagon__kbm.text: Park duh wagon! Wagon's aimed, now click inside yur glowin deployment zone to drop it.

t2_musterin__deploy_wagon__pad.text: Park duh wagon! Wagon's aimed and still in yur hand, droppin it is board work, so glide the left stick into yur glowin zone and press the A button to drop it.

t2_musterin__embark_boyz__kbm.text: Get in duh wagon! Under TRANSPORT EMBARKATION, tick Boyz, duh mob (and duh Boss with them) starts duh battle inside duh Battlewagon.

t2_musterin__embark_boyz__pad.text: Get in duh wagon! the D pad down walks down onto duh Boyz tickbox under TRANSPORT EMBARKATION, or glide the left stick onto it, dhen press the A button.

t2_musterin__first_turn_roll__kbm.text: Who goes first? yur Boyz are already in duh wagon, so muster's done. One last roll-off decides who takes duh first turn, Roll in duh dialog (again on a tie), dhen Continue.

t2_musterin__first_turn_roll__pad.text: Who goes first? duh Roll button takes duh pad focus, press the A button, again on a tie, dhen the A button on Continue.

t2_musterin__nudge_wagon__kbm.text: Shove it over! Parked a bit wonky? yur can shift a model dhats already down: hold Shift and click duh wagon to pick it up again, move duh mouse, dhen click to drop it. Right-click puts it back.

t2_musterin__nudge_wagon__pad.text: Shove it over! Parked a bit wonky? Point the left stick at duh wagon and press the left stick click to pick it up again, move it, dhen the A button to drop it. the B button puts it back where it was.

t2_musterin__roll_off__kbm.text: Roll duh bones! Deployment roll-off: click dice Roll the dice in duh dialog (roll again on a tie), dhen Continue, duh winner picks who deploys first.

t2_musterin__roll_off__pad.text: Roll duh bones! duh dialog's Roll button takes duh pad focus, just press the A button. Re-roll ties, dhen the A button on Continue.

t2_musterin__rotate_wagon__kbm.text: Point it duh right way! Click Battlewagon in duh list, a ghost follows yur mouse. its a long ol thing, so aim it BEFORE yah drop it: Q / E (or roll duh mouse wheel) turn it 15 degrees a tap. Give it a few taps.

t2_musterin__rotate_wagon__pad.text: Point it duh right way! Tap the right bumper till duh Battlewagon row is picked, a ghost follows the left stick. its a long ol thing, so aim it BEFORE yah drop it: hold the right stick click and tap the left bumper / the right bumper to turn it 15 degrees a tap. Give it a few taps.

t2_musterin__wrap__any.text: Muster complete! Army's on duh table: wagon loaded, grots spread, Boss ridin with his ladz. duh battle rounds start now, Get Movin teaches duh movement phase.

t3_get_movin___summary__any.text: Now we's rollin'! Click a unit's Embarked row to get duh boyz out of a transport, place each base inside duh glowin ring. An attached Warboss gets out with them, so his base gets placed too. Boyz dhat disembark can still make their own move, but only if duh transport ain't moved yet. Out first, drive after. Movement modes: pick duh radio, dhen Confirm Movement Mode, it don't stick till yah confirm. Drag models (or carry them with duh pad), Undo Model / Reset Unit fix mistakes. Big mob? Grab duh whole lot in one go, Select All on duh keyboard, D-pad up on duh pad, and one drag shifts them all. yah don't gotta spend a move in one drag, drop, grab again, duh inches add up till dhey're gone. Turnin a model is free in 11th, it don't cost a single inch of duh move. End This Unit's Move locks one unit. duh big red button ends duh whole phase. Next lesson: Dakka Time, shootin'.

t3_get_movin__boyz_move_after_disembark_.text: Deir legs still work! duh wagon ain't moved yet, so duh Boyz get their own move too. Press Control A to grab all 11, dhen one drag shifts duh whole mob. Droppin them ain't duh end, click End This Unit's Move to lock it in.

Deir legs still work! duh wagon ain't moved yet, so duh Boyz move too. the D pad up opens duh move menu, the A button takes Move. up again lifts all 11: glide the left stick and the A button drops duh lot. dhen the Menu button, End This Unit's Move, locks it in.

t3_get_movin__disembark_place__kbm.text: Inside duh ring! Click a spot inside duh glowin ring for each model, all 11 of them: 10 Boyz, dhen duh Warboss last, cos he's part of duh mob. Keep them close together and not on top of each uvver. duh move locks in after duh last one.

t3_get_movin__disembark_place__pad.text: Inside duh ring! Glide the left stick to a spot inside duh ring and press the A button for each model, all 11: 10 Boyz, dhen duh Warboss last. Keep them close, not stacked.

t3_get_movin__disembark_start__kbm.text: Everybody out! Click duh Boyz plus Warboss Embarked row in duh list, dhen click OK to start duh disembark.

t3_get_movin__disembark_start__pad.text: Everybody out! Tap the right bumper till duh Boyz plus Warboss Embarked row is picked, dhat pops duh disembark dialog on its own, dhen press the A button. Unit rows are bumper work; duh the D pad drives duh panels.

t3_get_movin__end_phase__kbm.text: Done here! duh grots can stay put, units don't have to move. Hit duh big red button to end duh Movement phase.

t3_get_movin__end_phase__pad.text: Done here! duh grots can stay put. Press the Menu button and confirm to end duh Movement phase.

t3_get_movin__intro__any.text: Movement phase! Every unit can move once a turn. Pick them from duh unit list on duh right, we'll get duh Boyz out of duh wagon first.

t3_get_movin__keep_da_roll__any.text: duh dice spoke! Advance adds a dee six to duh move, and when a roll's dhis important, duh game offers a Command Re-roll (costs 1 CP). We're keepin it: click Keep Roll.

t3_get_movin__wagon_confirm__kbm.text: Lock it in! Happy? End This Unit's Move locks duh wagon in. (Undo Model and Reset Unit are right next to it if yah ain't.)

t3_get_movin__wagon_confirm__pad.text: Lock it in! Press the Menu button, once duh models are down duh bar calls it Confirm Move, and dhat IS End This Unit's Move. (Mid-move duh the D pad s on models, not panels.)

t3_get_movin__wagon_mode__kbm.text: Put yur foot down! Now duh wagon: click Battlewagon in duh list, pick duh Advance radio, dhen hit Confirm Movement Mode, duh mode don't stick till yah confirm it!

t3_get_movin__wagon_mode__pad.text: Put yur foot down! Tap the right bumper till duh Battlewagon's picked, dhen the D pad up opens duh move menu. down onto Advance and the A button, dhat locks duh mode in, no Confirm button needed.

t3_get_movin__wagon_move__kbm.text: Shift it! Drag duh wagon's hull forward and drop it. yah don't gotta spend duh whole move in one drag, drop it, grab it again, keep goin'. duh panel counts every inch as yah go.

t3_get_movin__wagon_move__pad.text: Shift it! Press the A button on duh wagon to grab it, glide the left stick where yah want it, the A button to drop. yah don't gotta spend it all at once, grab it again and keep goin'. duh panel counts duh inches.

t3_get_movin__wagon_turn__kbm.text: Point it right! duh wagon ain't on a round base, so which way it points matters. Grab duh hull and keep holdin it, dhen tap Q or E, 15 degrees a tap. Turnin costs no inches.

t3_get_movin__wagon_turn__pad.text: Point it right! duh wagon ain't on a round base, so which way it points matters. the left bumper or the right bumper spins it 15 degrees a tap, in yur hand ( the A button grabs it) or sittin where yah dropped it. Turnin costs no inches.

t4_dakka___summary__any.text: Dakka dakka dakka! Click a unit (board or list) to make it duh shooter, dhen point each gun at somefin'. Pick a gun in duh weapon list, dhen click duh enemy, dhat gun's now aimed. All then <enemy> does every gun left in one go. In a real game, if only ONE enemy is in range and sight, duh guns aim demselves, we switched dhat off here so yah get duh practice. Confirm (N weapons) locks duh targets in and opens duh dice dock. Guns fire top-to-bottom down duh dock queue, up / down on duh right of each row re-orders them before duh first shot. Each gun rolls to hit, dhen to wound, dhen duh defender saves, kills from one gun are gone before duh next fires. Fast Roll All fast forward rolls everyfin'; Roll to Hit right goes step by step. Done closes each save card. Complete Shooting finishes duh unit, dhen pick duh next shooter or end duh phase. duh Dice Log tab on duh left panel keeps every roll, check it when a result looks fishy. Shoot All Remaining auto-fires every unit yah ain't bothered aimin yerself. Next lesson: here We Go!, chargin'.

t4_dakka__aim_da_rest__kbm.text: Now duh rest! duh Warboss is attached, so he's got guns too, and any row still readin (Click to Select) ain't firin'. Point duh lot at duh same mob: hit All then Witchseekers under duh weapon list, or click each row and dhen duh Witchseekers.

t4_dakka__aim_da_rest__pad.text: Now duh rest! duh Warboss is attached, so he's got guns too, any row still readin (Click to Select) ain't firin'. the D pad up down to duh next gun, the A button to aim it at duh Witchseekers, and again till every row says then Witchseekers.

t4_dakka__aim_first_gun__kbm.text: Point one gun! Time to aim. Click duh Slugga row in duh weapon list on duh right to pick dhat gun, dhen click duh Witchseekers on duh board. duh row swaps from (Click to Select) to then Witchseekers, dhats one gun aimed.

t4_dakka__aim_first_gun__pad.text: Point one gun! Time to aim. the D pad up down walks yur guns, stop on duh Slugga. the D pad left right walks duh enemy targets. with duh Slugga picked and duh Witchseekers highlighted, press the A button to aim it. duh row swaps to then Witchseekers.

t4_dakka__confirm_dakka__kbm.text: Lock duh targets! Every gun's pointed, now lock them in: click duh glowin Confirm button on duh right (it counts yur guns).

t4_dakka__confirm_dakka__pad.text: Lock duh targets! Every gun's pointed, now lock them in: press the Menu button, dhats Confirm Targets on duh pad. Want to re-aim first? the D pad left right walks duh targets, up down walks yur guns, the A button aims duh current gun.

t4_dakka__dice_log__kbm.text: Check duh numbers! Every one of dhem rolls got written down. Click duh Dice Log tab on duh panel down duh left, hits, wounds and saves, duh lot of it.

t4_dakka__dice_log__pad.text: Check duh numbers! Every roll got written down. duh left panel ain't on duh the D pad route, so dhis is cursor work: glide the left stick onto duh Dice Log tab and press the A button, hits, wounds and saves, duh lot of it.

t4_dakka__end_phase__kbm.text: Ceasefire! duh wagon and duh grots could shoot too, (Shoot All Remaining does them all in one go), but we're savin duh ammo. Hit duh big red button, check duh phase summary, dhen End Shooting Phase.

t4_dakka__end_phase__pad.text: Ceasefire! duh wagon and grots could shoot too, we're savin ammo. Press the Menu button, dhen confirm End Shooting Phase on duh summary.

t4_dakka__intro__any.text: Shootin time! duh Boyz are out of duh wagon and duh Witchseekers are in slugga range. In duh Shooting phase every unit gets one go at blastin, let's teach yur trigger fingers.

t4_dakka__pick_da_boyz__kbm.text: Oi, you lot! Click yur Boyz mob, on duh board or in duh unit list on duh right. duh weapon list on duh right fills up with every gun dhey've got, all sayin (Click to Select), nothing's aimed yet.

t4_dakka__pick_da_boyz__pad.text: Oi, you lot! Tap the right bumper till duh Boyz are duh active shooter, the right bumper cycles yur units, dhats duh only control dhat does. duh weapon list on duh right shows every gun dhey've got, none of them aimed yet.

t4_dakka__roll_da_dice__kbm.text: Let them rip! duh declarin panel's gone and duh WEAPON RESOLUTION dock's took its place on duh right. Each row is one gun pointed at one mob, with duh damage we reckon it'll do, and dhey fire top to bottom, one gun goes all duh way frough before duh next one starts. Every gun rolls duh same three steps: hit rolls against its Ballistic Skill, dhen wound rolls (yur Strength against deir Toughness), dhen duh defender makes savin throws and whatever gets frough does damage and takes models off. duh firin order is yours to pick. duh up and down buttons on duh right-hand side of each row shove dhat gun up or down duh queue, only while its still waitin', so sort it now. It matters: boyz killed by duh first gun ain't dere to soak up duh second. When yur happy: Fast Roll All fast forward rolls everyfin at once, or Roll to Hit right walks it step by step. Enemy saves pop up a results card, click Done on each. When duh big button says Complete Shooting, click it to finish duh mob's go.

t4_dakka__roll_da_dice__pad.text: Let them rip! dhats duh WEAPON RESOLUTION dock on duh right. Each row is one gun pointed at one mob, and dhey fire top to bottom, one gun all duh way frough (hit rolls on its Ballistic Skill, dhen wound rolls Strength against Toughness, dhen duh defender's savin throws and duh damage) before duh next one starts. duh firin order is yours to pick. Press the D pad to walk duh highlight up into duh queue and onto duh up / down buttons on duh right-hand side of each row, dhen the A button to shove dhat gun up or down. Only works before duh first shot, and it matters: boyz killed by duh first gun ain't dere to soak up duh second. dhen the D pad back down to Fast Roll All fast forward and press the A button, the A button on each Done card, dhen the A button on Complete Shooting.

t5_ere_we_go___summary__any.text: here we go, here we go! Pick duh chargin unit, tick duh target(s) in duh list, dhen Declare Charge. Roll two dee six, dhats how far every model can move. Too short and duh charge fails. A Command Re-roll (1 CP) gets offered on duh charge roll, take it if yah came up short. Snap to Contact shoves duh whole mob into base contact; drag them yerself if yah want it tidy. Confirm Charge Moves locks it. Chargin units fight first next phase. Next lesson: Krumpin, duh Fight phase.

t5_ere_we_go__confirm__kbm.text: Lock it in! Hit Confirm Charge Moves to finish duh charge. duh mob's now in engagement, and chargin units strike first in duh Fight phase.

t5_ere_we_go__confirm__pad.text: Lock it in! Press the Menu button to Confirm Charge once every declared target is reached.

t5_ere_we_go__declare__kbm.text: Pick yur scrap! Click duh Boyz in duh unit list, tick Custodian Guard in duh target list, dhen hit Declare Charge.

t5_ere_we_go__declare__pad.text: Pick yur scrap! Tap the right bumper till duh Boyz are picked. the D pad left right walks duh target ring, put it on duh Custodian Guard and press the A button to toggle them in. dhen the Menu button to Declare Charge.

t5_ere_we_go__end_phase__kbm.text: dhats duh lot! duh wagon and duh grots ain't chargin today. Hit duh big red button to end duh Charge phase.

t5_ere_we_go__end_phase__pad.text: dhats duh lot! duh wagon and grots ain't chargin'. Press the Menu button and confirm to end duh phase.

t5_ere_we_go__intro__any.text: Charge phase! duh Boyz shot them up, now dhey wanna get stuck in. Chargin is three steps: declare who yah want, roll two dee six, dhen move into contact. Fail duh roll and dhey don't move at all.

t5_ere_we_go__keep_da_roll__kbm.text: Good enuff! Nine inches, plenty. duh game offers a Command Re-roll on any charge roll (1 CP) in case yah come up short; we don't need it. Click Keep Roll.

t5_ere_we_go__keep_da_roll__pad.text: Good enuff! duh re-roll offer takes its own the D pad / the A button, pick Keep Roll and press the A button.

t5_ere_we_go__move_in__kbm.text: Into them! Now shift duh mob. Drag each model, or just hit Snap to Contact and duh whole lot piles into base contact. duh panel counts how many still need placin'.

t5_ere_we_go__move_in__pad.text: Into them! Press the X button, dhats Snap to Contact, it piles duh whole mob in. ( the A button grabs one model, the left stick click swaps model, the B button undoes one.)

t5_ere_we_go__roll__kbm.text: Roll duh bones! Hit Roll two dee six. Whatever yah roll is how many inches every model in duh mob gets, and dhey all gotta end up wivin engagement range for it to count.

t5_ere_we_go__roll__pad.text: Roll duh bones! Press the Menu button, on duh pad dhats Roll two dee six.

t6_krumpin___summary__any.text: Get stuck in! duh Fight phase opens with Pile In, every engaged unit may shuffle 3 inches closer. Skip it with End Pile In. Click a unit in UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT to activate it. Units dhat charged swing first, all of them, before duh enemy gets a look in. In duh attack panel: pick one melee weapon, pick duh target, Weapon to Target, dhen Fight!. duh dice dock rolls it out, Fast Roll fast forward does duh lot, Done tick finishes duh activation. dhen duh enemy activates and duh dock rolls deir hits and wounds at yah, you roll duh saves and can spend a Command Re-roll. You and duh enemy alternate activations till everyone's swung. Last lesson: Runnin duh Show.

t6_krumpin__assign_attacks__kbm.text: Pick yur choppa! Each model fights with one melee weapon. Pick a weapon in duh list, click duh Custodian Guard target, hit Weapon to Target, dhen Fight!

t6_krumpin__assign_attacks__pad.text: Pick yur choppa! duh attack panel takes its own controls: the D pad up down picks duh weapon, left right picks duh target, the A button assigns them, dhen the Menu button for Fight!

t6_krumpin__boss_swings__kbm.text: duh boss ain't swung yet! duh Warboss charged and all, so he's Fights First too, duh Custodes wait till he's swung. Click Warboss, Decline duh Epic Challenge offer, assign his weapon and Fight!

t6_krumpin__boss_swings__pad.text: duh boss ain't swung yet! duh Warboss charged and all, so he's Fights First too. duh the D pad is parked down on duh dice dock, tap up till it lands on duh Warboss row, dhen the A button. Decline duh Epic Challenge, assign his weapon, dhen the Menu button for Fight!

t6_krumpin__end_phase__kbm.text: dhats enough krumpin'! Everyone dhat could swing has swung, so duh phase is done, hit duh big red button to end it.

t6_krumpin__end_phase__pad.text: dhats enough krumpin'! Everyone's swung, so duh phase is done, press the Menu button to end it.

t6_krumpin__enemy_swings__kbm.text: Now dhey krump back! Both yur mobs have swung, so its duh Custodes turn, dhats alternatin activation. duh dock rolls deir hits and wounds; step frough it, dhen Roll Saves on duh card and spend a Command Re-roll if a save lets yah down.

t6_krumpin__enemy_swings__pad.text: Now dhey krump back! duh Custodes swing back now. Step frough deir rolls on duh dock with the A button. duh save card takes duh the D pad on its own and already sits on Roll Saves, just press the A button.

t6_krumpin__intro__any.text: Fight phase! duh Boyz and duh Warboss made it in, now dhey get to krump. Every engaged unit fights once, and units dhat charged all go before duh enemy does. It starts with a Pile In step.

t6_krumpin__pick_fighter__kbm.text: Boyz first! Click Boyz under UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT. dhey charged, so dhey swing before duh Custodes do.

t6_krumpin__pick_fighter__pad.text: Boyz first! the D pad down walks duh fight panel onto duh Boyz row, the A button presses it. dhey charged, so dhey swing first.

t6_krumpin__pile_in__kbm.text: Shuffle up! Pile In lets every engaged unit move 3 inches closer to duh enemy. yur Boyz are already in contact, so just hit End Pile In.

t6_krumpin__pile_in__pad.text: Shuffle up! yur Boyz are already in contact, just press the Menu button, duh bar calls it End Pile In. Or the D pad down lands right on duh button, dhen the A button.

t6_krumpin__roll_it_out__kbm.text: Krump them! Same dice dock as shootin': Fast Roll fast forward rolls hits, wounds and saves in one go (or step frough with duh big button). Finish with Done tick.

t6_krumpin__roll_it_out__pad.text: Krump them! duh dock starts on Roll to Wound right, the D pad down drops onto Fast Roll fast forward, dhen the A button. Clear any save cards, dhen Done tick.

t7_runnin_da_show___summary__any.text: youse duh boss now! Every battle round starts with duh Command phase: plus 1 CP, dhen yur secondary missions. duh mission review shows what yur scorin for, Discard one for a CP, or Replace it for a CP. Army rules live in duh command panel, CALL DUH WAAAGH! is once per battle. Stratagems spends CP any time its legal; Missions and Roster show scorin and yur army. dhats duh lot, every phase, every button. Now go krump somefin for real.

t7_runnin_da_show__end_command__kbm.text: On with it! dhats duh Command phase. End Command Phase moves yah on to Movement, and round two runs Movement, Shootin', Charge, Fight, Scorin', same as round one.

t7_runnin_da_show__end_command__pad.text: On with it! Press the Menu button to end duh Command phase and move on to Movement.

t7_runnin_da_show__mission_choice__kbm.text: duh mission wants somefin'! Some missions ask yah to make a choice duh moment dhey're drawn. dhis one wants a guard on each objective. yah can pick them yerself, or take duh game's suggestion with Keep Auto Picks.

t7_runnin_da_show__mission_choice__pad.text: duh mission wants somefin'! Some missions want a choice when dhey're drawn, dhis one wants guards on objectives. the D pad to Keep Auto Picks, dhen the A button to take duh game's suggestion.

t7_runnin_da_show__review_missions__kbm.text: Battle round two! duh Custodes had deir go, now every round opens with duh Command phase: bank a CP, sort yur secondaries, fire off army rules. dhis card lists duh missions yah can score dhis round and what each pays. yah could Replace one for 1 CP, we'll keep them. Click Continue.

t7_runnin_da_show__review_missions__pad.text: Battle round two! Every round opens with duh Command phase: a CP, yur secondaries, dhen army rules. dhis card lists what yah can score, the D pad moves duh highlight, the A button presses. Pick Continue.

t7_runnin_da_show__stratagems__kbm.text: Spend duh cp! CP buys stratagems. Open duh panel with Stratagems at duh bottom, it lists what yah can use right now, what it costs, and greys out duh rest with duh reason why. Have a look, dhen hit Close.

t7_runnin_da_show__stratagems__pad.text: Spend duh cp! CP buys stratagems. duh bottom bar ain't on duh the D pad route, so glide the left stick onto Stratagems and press the A button, duh panel lists what yah can use now and greys out duh rest with duh reason why. Have a look, dhen Close.

t7_runnin_da_show__waaagh__kbm.text: Waaaaagh! Army rules sit in duh command panel. duh Orks get one big un: hit CALL DUH WAAAGH!, once per battle, every Ork can Advance and still charge, hits harder in melee and gets a 5 plus invuln.

t7_runnin_da_show__waaagh__pad.text: Waaaaagh! Army rules sit in duh command panel. the D pad down hops in, down again lands on CALL DUH WAAAGH!, the A button calls it. Once per battle, and every Ork gets meaner.

t7_runnin_da_show__wrap__any.text: Trainin done! dhats every phase and every button: musterin', movin', shootin', chargin', krumpin and runnin duh show. duh rest is just playin'. WAAAGH!
